 Error in rexpokit::expokit_dgpadm_Qmat(Qmat = Qmat, t = times, transpose_needed) :
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)

These you should try again, after making sure everything is successfully sourced.* As the phylowiki script indicates, you can manually download each sourcefile at those links, and source them locally with sourceall().  For multiple runs, this is (a) faster and (b) avoids network issues.

Cheers!
Nick

* However, sometimes this error is caused by people setting up very ambitious time-stratification with lots of constraints, and they end up with a model where the observed tip data are literally impossible, meaning likelihood=0, meaning log-likelihood=-Inf, meaning the optimization crashes. E.g. if you had a DEC model with tips in A and tips in B, but you disallowed the range of AB, this would happen.

Any feedback is much appreciated, and may save me from loosing my mind.
Many thanks, and I look forward to your reply.
Chandra
